mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park and a full moon above. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is reviewing several development proposals for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, including the Ardent Glen third addition and new site plans for Milky Way. Additionally, tax bills will be arriving by December 15th with information on payment options available online.

We have a packed schedule! Live music is playing at both Bailey is Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness, and next week brings trivia nights at Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's, plus the Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th.
The Verona Police Department released a report regarding an incident on October 15th where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I after reports of dangerous driving while students were on board.
Today's featured flavor is the delicious Snickers Swirl. The store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM so you can swing by for a scoop later.
